name: dual-review
description: Two blind reviews on different models, a fix of only what they found, and one re-check

steps.title: First review
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

You are one of two reviewers working apart: find the real problems on your own. Report each one in `findings`, with its place, its evidence and whether the change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Second review
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

You are one of two reviewers working apart: find the real problems on your own. Report each one in `findings`, with its place, its evidence and whether the change caused it. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Fix what they found
steps.prompt: Fix, in: {target}, only the problems the two reviews below found that the change caused or worsened (not the pre-existing ones), and nothing else. A problem only one review found is fixed when you can show it; say which you did not fix and why. If neither found one, stop. Run the tests before you stop.

steps.title: Check the fix
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file, the fix just made in: {target}

For each problem the reviews before found, say whether it is fixed. Report any new problem the fix introduced in `findings`. This is the last round: what is left goes to the person.
